args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. Covey & Lark, Covey, and CLR all refer to the same customer.
- CRM code changed from CLR to PHL. PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so check the dropdown when filing tickets.
- The Pemberline Dock export and at least one saved report still use the old name. The saved report is titled "Covey — Late Arrivals" and should be relabelled to Pellow Home Living.
- Receiving teams already use the new name on appointment sheets, so the old label has caused confusion (for example, a driver was sent to the office at door 6 on 16 Feb).
- Ask: relabel the saved report and the Pemberline Dock export template to Pellow Home Living, and confirm the CRM name and code are updated.
- Rows mix up two accounts: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia (with Bettina Kroll)
